days.title: The Voice in Your Head Is Lying to You
days.featured_quote: You are allowed to be a work in progress and still be worthy of kindness.
script_lines: There's a voice in your head that's too harsh.
It criticizes things a friend would never say.
You'd never speak to someone else this way.
That voice isn't the truth — it's just loud.
Self-compassion means catching it before it lands.
You can notice it without obeying it.
Today, try answering it with something softer.

days.subtheme: You Don't Have to Earn Rest
days.title: You Don't Have to Earn Your Rest
days.featured_quote: Rest is not something you've earned. It's something you're owed.
script_lines: You've been taught rest is something you earn.
Like it's a reward for being productive enough.
But rest isn't a prize — it's a need.
Your worth was never tied to your output.
You can stop today without finishing everything.
Permission isn't something you have to ask for.
You're allowed to rest simply because you're tired.

days.subtheme: Talking to Yourself Like a Friend
days.title: Would You Say That to a Friend?
days.featured_quote: Be the friend to yourself that you've always needed.
script_lines: Think about how you'd comfort a close friend.
Now notice how differently you talk to yourself.
Your inner voice deserves the same gentleness.
Try saying your own name when you're struggling.
Speak to yourself like someone you love.
This isn't indulgent — it's basic kindness.
You're both the one hurting and the one who can help.

days.title: A Mistake Is Not Your Whole Story
days.featured_quote: A mistake is a moment. It is not your whole story.
script_lines: You made a mistake. That's it. Just one.
It doesn't rewrite everything good about you.
One moment isn't the whole story of you.
Shame wants you to believe you're the mistake.
You are not the worst thing you've done.
Growth means being wrong and staying kind to yourself.
Let this one go. You're allowed to.

days.title: You're Not Behind — You're Just Comparing
days.featured_quote: You are not behind in a race no one else is actually running.
script_lines: Someone else's timeline isn't a verdict on yours.
You're comparing your behind-the-scenes to their highlight reel.
Their healing pace has nothing to do with yours.
Comparison convinces you that you're behind — you're not.
You're exactly where your own life is right now.
Close the tab. Come back to your own breath.
Your pace is allowed to be your own.

days.title: Your Body Deserves Softer Words
days.featured_quote: Your body isn't a project. It's been with you the whole time.
script_lines: Self-compassion isn't only about your thoughts.
It's also how you talk about your body.
Your body has carried you through everything so far.
It deserves gentler words than you've been giving it.
You don't need to earn comfort through its appearance.
Thank it today instead of critiquing it.
Gentleness is a better motivator than shame ever was.

days.title: You're Doing Better Than You Think
days.featured_quote: You don't have to be perfect to deserve a gentle ending to your week.
script_lines: You made it through another week of trying.
Some days were heavier than others. That's okay.
You don't have to have done it perfectly.
Showing up, imperfectly, still counts as showing up.
Let this week end without one more harsh word.
You deserve the same kindness you give everyone else.
Close tonight gently. You're doing better than you think.
